subject: Kickoff: Aligning HelioHealth renewal to AWS marketplace & co-sell path
messages:
From: Aisha Desai <aisha.desai@heliohealth.com>
To: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Vega <c.vega@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to move renewal to AWS Marketplace and explore co-sell

Hi Connor,

Quick note from HelioHealth procurement as we approach our contract renewal in June. Procurement has been pushing for marketplace billing (AWS Marketplace) for all SaaS line items to simplify internal approvals and get better cloud spend governance. They also mentioned they prefer vendors that are co-sell enabled with AWS.

Our use of Redwood has scaled and the renewal is positive, but before our terms are finalized we wanted to confirm whether Redwood can accept marketplace invoicing for this renewal and whether you can support the co-sell enablement steps.

Attached is a short POC summary and our expected renewal volumes. Can we schedule a 30-minute sync next week to walk through timelines, pricing alignment, and required paperwork (PO vs invoice cadence, entitlements)?

Thanks,
Aisha Desai
Head of Procurement, HelioHealth
Aisha.desai@heliohealth.com
Attachment: HelioHealth_POC.pdf
From: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Desai <aisha.desai@heliohealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move renewal to AWS Marketplace and explore co-sell

Hi Aisha — thanks for the context and the POC. Congrats on the expansion — excited to support.

High level next steps I propose:
- Quick discovery call (30m) to align on contract end date, PO requirements, and who signs for HelioHealth
- Marissa will coordinate pricing and any commercial adjustments for marketplace listing
- Ben will confirm invoicing flow and tax implications for marketplace vs direct billing
- Sergio will loop in our AWS partner contact to start the co-sell paperwork and identify next steps for entitlements/listing

A few quick questions to prepare the call:
1) Exact contract expiry date and any auto-renew windows?
2) Does procurement require that the invoice be issued by AWS Marketplace or is a vendor-side marketplace listing acceptable?
3) Is there an internal catalog/supplier ID we should reference for the listing?

Proposed meeting times: Wed 04/28 9:30-10:00 PT or Thu 04/29 11:00-11:30 PT. Which works?

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Desai <aisha.desai@heliohealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move renewal to AWS Marketplace and explore co-sell

Aisha / team — thanks, can confirm Wed 04/28 9:30 PT works for us. I pulled some quick notes after reviewing the POC and current usage:

- Renewal window: current MSA end date is 2027-06-15, auto-renews 30 days if not amended.
- Typical procurement asks for an AWS-issued invoice. We can create a marketplace listing so AWS invoices HelioHealth directly.
- Pricing: to preserve ARR math we may need a marketplace list price that mirrors the direct quote; we can offer a one-time migration credit to keep totalTCO neutral during the first year.
- Co-sell: we'll need to submit the AWS co-sell form, provide contact for seller partner account, and confirm entitlements (seat counts, API limits).

Attaching a draft SOW and the AWS checklist so we can walk through items on the call.

Attachments: Draft_SOW.docx, AWS_CoSell_Form.pdf

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Cho <erin.cho@amazon.com>, connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Desai <aisha.desai@heliohealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: HelioHealth marketplace/ co-sell kickoff (intro to AWS contact)

Hi Erin — looping you in on HelioHealth, a fast-growing healthcare customer looking to move their Redwood subscription to AWS Marketplace and enable co-sell. Aisha is the procurement lead.

High-level asks from HelioHealth:
- Move June renewal (MSA end 2027-06-15) to an AWS Marketplace listing so AWS can invoice HelioHealth directly
- Complete the co-sell enablement form and confirm entitlements for our listing
- Understand any latency on AWS-side approval for the co-sell enablement (Helio is requesting a May cutoff so procurement can approve PO)

Erin, can you confirm the typical timeline for seller registration + co-sell approval and any paperwork Helio should expect? Also, please advise if there are special steps for healthcare orgs regarding entitlements or contract attachments.

Thanks — Sergio Alvarez
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
From: Procurement <procurement@heliohealth.com>
To: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aisha Desai <aisha.desai@heliohealth.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: HelioHealth PO for renewal (request: invoice from AWS Marketplace)

Hello Connor,

Attached is HelioHealth PO-Helio-2027-04.pdf for the upcoming renewal coverage. Per our policy, our purchasing team requires invoice issuance from AWS Marketplace for vendor SaaS items so we can route payment through cloud provider billing. Could you confirm Redwood will accept the PO and that the invoice will originate from AWS Marketplace?

If Redwood needs a DocuSign amendment or an updated SOW that references the marketplace listing, please let us know and we will expedite review.

Procurement Team
HelioHealth
Attachment: PO-Helio-2027-04.pdf
From: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Procurement <procurement@heliohealth.com>, Aisha Desai <aisha.desai@heliohealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelioHealth PO for renewal (request: invoice from AWS Marketplace)

Hi all — confirmed. We will accept the PO and are starting the marketplace onboarding today. Summary of agreed next steps:

1) Sergio will submit the AWS co-sell form and start seller registration — expected AWS ack in 7-10 business days.
2) Ben will coordinate tax and billing mappings so the invoice can be issued by AWS Marketplace for HelioHealth.
3) Lauren (legal) will draft a short MSA amendment referencing the marketplace listing and entitlements; Marissa will attach the finalized SOW for Helio sign-off.
4) We will apply a one-time migration credit (as discussed) to neutralize the first-year billing impact for Helio; details in HubSpot.

Marissa — please confirm final list price for the listing and I will share required supplier contact info with AWS. Aisha / Procurement — we aim to have AWS-side invoice ability in place before 2027-05-15 to give you time for internal approval.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
